title: Wilted Sunday Saudi Arabian Callaloo Nimono-Simmer
description: A sour, molten, lazy-Sunday Saudi Arabian dish featuring callaloo, nimono-simmer, and high-protein ingredients served in a Korean brass bowl.

ingredients.name: Nimono-Simmer Broth
ingredients.notes: Low-sodium chicken broth and water mixture.

instructions: Heat ghee in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add callaloo and nimono-simmer broth, and stir to combine.
Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in lemon juice and season with salt and black pepper.
Serve in a Korean brass bowl, garnished with lemon wedges, if desired.
